properties.entry: INSERT INTO products(product_name, sku, catagery, unit, cost_price, selling_price, quantity, status) VALUES(:productName, :sku, :catagery, :unit, :costPrice, :sellingPrice, :quantity, :status)
UPDATE products SET product_name = :productName, sku=:sku, catagery=:catagery, unit=:unit, cost_price=:costPrice, selling_price=:sellingPrice, quantity=:quantity WHERE id = :id
UPDATE products SET status='DELETED' WHERE id = :id
SELECT id,product_name, sku, catagery, unit, cost_price, selling_price, quantity, status FROM products WHERE status!='DELETED'
SELECT product_name, sku, catagery, unit, cost_price, selling_price, quantity, status WHERE id=:id
INSERT INTO warehouse(name, code, city, address, status) VALUES(:name, :code, :city, :address, :status)
UPDATE warehouse SET name = :name, code=:code, city = :city, address=:address, status=:status, updated_on = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:id
UPDATE warehouse SET status=:status, updated_on = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:id
SELECT id,name, code, city, address, status FROM warehouse where status!='DELETED'
SELECT id,name, code, city, address, status FROM warehouse where status!='DELETED' AND id =:id
